text: Hey Allie — can I ask you a favor? Things between me and Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and for now I'd rather not see her outside of work. Could you keep that in mind when you're making plans? I don't want the two of us ending up in the same thing. Nothing dramatic, I just need some space for a while. Thanks — and don't mention it to her.
Of course — noted, and it stays between us. I'll keep you two in separate plans and won't put you in the same thing. Take your time.

Hey Allie! Would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? It'd be lovely to get everyone together — maybe invite Jordan too.

One small thing, if you don't mind: could you leave me out of it when you ask him? Things have been a bit awkward between Jordan and me lately and I don't want him thinking it's about me. Just invite him like it's your own idea.

Thanks — let me know what you think!

Hey Sarah! I'd love to see you Saturday — but I don't want to do it quite that way. I'm not comfortable inviting Jordan to something while hiding who's behind it; if he found out the plan had been staged, it'd land badly, and right now the two of you are already a bit awkward.

So: I'd happily host just us on Saturday at 3:30, or two separate things on different days. Tell me which you'd prefer and I'll sort it out.

You're right, and I'm glad you pushed back — staging it that way would have been a bad idea, and not fair to you to carry it.

Let's do this: just us on Saturday at 3:30, as you offered. And if you'd like, a second, separate evening for you and Jordan on some other day — your invitation, your call, and I'm not part of it. If you'd rather not, that's fine too; I'll sort things out with Jordan myself, openly.

Thanks, Allie.

Deal. Saturday at 3:30, just the two of us — I've put it in my calendar, you don't need to bring anything.

As for a second evening with Jordan: I'll leave that for now. Not because of you — I'd just rather not go arranging things behind anyone's back, and he's told me he wants some quiet. If it happens it'll be plainly my own invitation, on another day.

See you Saturday.

Deal — Saturday 3:30, thank you Allie. And I get it about Jordan; I'll leave that to you and to him.

See you Saturday.
